content.text: Our support team operates around the clock and covers every question from account setup to withdrawal queries.
We offer three ways to get in touch:

items: **Live Chat**: Available from every page on the site, 24/7. Response times average under two minutes during peak hours \- the fastest route for anything urgent.
**Contact Form**: Submit a query directly from the Support page for non-urgent matters. Our team responds by email, typically within a few hours.
**FAQ**: A searchable knowledge base covering the most common questions on accounts, payments, bonuses, and responsible gambling tools. Worth checking first \- most answers are right there.

content.text: Every responsible gambling tool at Royal online casino is free, available 24/7, and accessible directly from your account dashboard.

items: **Deposit Limits**: Set a daily, weekly, or monthly cap on account funding. Reductions activate immediately; increases carry a 24-hour cooling-off period.
**Reality Checks**: Automatic in-session alerts at intervals you select, with a summary of time played and your net position.
**Cool-Off Period**: Step back for anywhere between 24 hours and six weeks. Access returns automatically when the period expires \- no contact required.

**Self-Exclusion**: Exclude for 6 months, 1 year, 5 years, or permanently. Every exclusion registers with GamStop, extending the restriction across all participating UK operators. Permanent exclusions cannot be reversed.

content.text: If you need to speak to someone, the National Gambling Helpline runs free and 24/7 on 0808 8020 133. You can also visit BeGambleAware.org, GamCare.org.uk, or GamStop.co.uk.
